notes.title: World of Turtle: Puzzle Party!
notes.notes:
Get the game on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43410425/d7cfd7a4783599f79acc30f279c980edb5b97408.png[/img]

Join Babo Turtle in World of Turtle, a hilarious Sokoban-style puzzle adventure featured in Steam’s Box-Pushing Fest 2025! Navigate 100 challenging levels across 10 vibrant stages, each packed with clever obstacles like collapsing grounds, slippery ice, and mischievous creatures—think cunning crocodiles, kickable penguins, and dodgy gorillas. Your mission? Push penguins, collect delicious fruits, and guide Babo to the helicopter for a triumphant escape.

With intuitive controls (keyboard or gamepad), auto-save progress, and 5 skip passes (earnable by replaying levels), this game is as accessible as it is addictive. Unlock the Jukebox to groove to each stage’s unique soundtrack, and enjoy a family-friendly, cartoony 2.5D world that’s equal parts relaxing and brain-teasing. Originally a passion project coded in Basic with ASCII graphics, World of Turtle has been remade in TypeScript and WebGL for Steam, delivering polished visuals and seamless gameplay.

Available in English, French, and Korean, it’s a global turtle party! Dive into this indie gem, conquer the puzzles, and discover surprises waiting at the finish line. Grab World of Turtle now and push your way to victory!

notes.title: Spring Turtle Dash: World of Turtle Sale!
notes.notes:
🌿 [b]Hop Into Spring with World of Turtle![/b] 🌿  
The Steam Spring Sale is here, and *World of Turtle* is joining the party with a shell-shocking discount! This quirky Sokoban-style puzzle adventure drops you into 100 levels of turtle-tastic chaos. Guide Babo Turtle past collapsing grounds, slippery ice, and a cast of wild characters—kickable penguins, sneaky crocodiles, and gorillas you’ll want to avoid. Your goal? Snag all the juicy fruits and race to the helicopter landing zone for a victorious getaway.

[h2]Why You’ll Love This Turtle Trek:[/h2]
- [b]More than 100 Levels, 10 Stages:[/b] Each packed with unique obstacles like breakable blocks, rolling carpets, and transporting turtles.  
- [b]Retro Roots, Modern Shine:[/b] Born from ASCII Basic, evolved through Flash, and now remade in JavaScript/WebGL for Steam.  
- [b]Cute Chaos:[/b] Penguins to punt, crocodiles to outwit, and a soundtrack that’ll have you humming along (unlock the Jukebox!).  
- [b]Play Your Way:[/b] Gamepad or keyboard (AZERTY/QWERTY/Z), auto-saves, and 5 skip passes you can earn back.  

This isn’t just a game—it’s a passion project decades in the making, now polished and ready for Steam. The Spring Sale won’t last long, so grab *World of Turtle* at this unbeatable price and see if you’ve got what it takes to outsmart the dangers (and those pesky gorillas). Share your triumphs with #TurtleSpring—let’s roll through this adventure together!

🌟 [b]Snag It Before It Flies Away:[/b] Dive in now and start collecting those fruits!

notes.title: Small update. Just showing the Stage number at the beginning of each stage.
notes.notes:
Alright, so we here's another update. All I'm adding is the stage in big text in the beginning of each stage. Well it's not all that significant, but you know, sometimes I just sit around and think about what to add to my game, then just add it!

Anyway, I hope it makes it more significant when you enter a new stage!

notes.title: Major update with CutScenes!
notes.notes:
So I've decided to add some cut-scenes into the game. Is that something the game needed? Well... not really, but it does provide a nice way to know about each characters.
Nothing really fancy, just two characters having a nice conversation, but you get to know about their personality and backstory.

- At the beginning of each stage, you will get a little cut-scene, and a bit more if you keep failing that same level over and over.
- In the middle of each stage, you also get a cut-scene.

notes.title: World of Turtle 1.0.2 Patch update
notes.notes:
- Added Fan Art gallery and included fan art in loading screen.
Fans can contribute to World of Turtle! (subject to approval).
You can show your art as a loading screen, or within the art gallery.
For more details, please ping me directly at jacklehamster@gmail.com.

- Updated some levels in stage 5 that were difficult to play
World of Turtle focuses on thinking. Some levels in stage 5 were a bit dependent on speed and agility, so we had to decrease their difficulty.
